title: Conic Structure of the Cross-Entropy Loss at the Final Layer and Its Absence in Rectifier Backbones
abstract: arXiv:2611.20696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Slices of the loss along lines and planes in parameter space are widely used to visualize deep networks. They often show a single basin with nearly straight walls, which raises the question of whether such a loss is a cone rounded at its apex, or a lower envelope of several cones that meet along creases. We answer this question for softmax cross-entropy at two levels of a classifier. Over the weights of an affine final layer, the loss equals a polyhedral cone plus an offset that decreases monotonically and exponentially along every ray, towards a limit in closed form. The distance at which the asymptotic wall reaches the height of the starting point, which we call the core radius, equals the mean surprisal of the classes that the direction favours, divided by the slope of the wall. Over the parameters of a rectifier backbone, the loss along a line has a kink wherever the activation pattern of a sample changes. Using the dimension theory

translated_title: 最终层交叉熵损失的锥形结构及其在整流器主干网络中的缺失
translated_abstract: 沿参数空间中的直线和平面对损失进行切片被广泛用于深度网络的可视化。这些切片通常呈现出一个具有近乎笔直侧壁的单一盆地，这引发了一个问题：这样的损失究竟是一个在顶点处被圆化的锥体，还是多个沿褶皱相交的锥体的下包络。我们在分类器的两个层级上对softmax交叉熵回答了这一问题。在仿射最终层的权重上，损失等于一个多面锥加上一个沿每条射线单调且指数递减的偏移量，并趋向于一个具有闭式表达式的极限。渐近侧壁达到起始点高度的距离（我们称之为核心半径），等于该方向所偏向的类别的平均惊异度除以侧壁的斜率。在整流器主干网络的参数上，沿直线的损失在样本激活模式发生变化的地方会出现折点。利用维度理论（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文证明了softmax交叉熵损失在仿射最终层权重上严格等于一个多面锥加指数递减偏移的结构（并提出“核心半径”刻画其几何特性），而在ReLU整流器主干网络中，由于激活模式变化产生折点，这种锥形结构并不存在。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the softmax cross-entropy loss over an affine final layer is exactly a polyhedral cone plus an exponentially decreasing offset (characterized by a novel "core radius"), while this conic structure is absent in rectifier backbones due to kinks caused by changing activation patterns.
